title: Social Listening Report — 07:00–07:30 ET

fields.from: Social listening tool, scheduled half-hourly report
fields.to: Tessa Brandt, Social Media Manager; Corporate Communications listening inbox
fields.summary: Total 'Tallis' mentions: 1,140 in the period, up 410 percent on the 30-day baseline for this half-hour (224). Top narrative (68 percent, about 775 mentions): 'Tallis air fryer recall??', started at 07:03 by @CrispyKitchenMom (2,100 followers): "heard Tallis is recalling the 5qt air fryer, anyone know?? #TallisRecall". Replies link a competitor's air fryer recall story from last week. Second narrative (19 percent, about 217 mentions): users quoting the status.tallishome.example notice 'Scheduled maintenance 02:00–04:00 ET completed', e.g. @dealhunter_dayton at 07:11: "tallis site was down overnight, sketchy." Keywords 'Tallis hack' / 'Tallis breach': 31 mentions, first match 07:18, rising. Two accounts have shared a screenshot of a forum post. Largest: @DataLeakWatcher_x (14,800 followers), 07:24: "Seller on a breach forum claims 1.9M Tallis Home customer accounts w/ passwords + cards, 200-row sample posted. If you shop tallishome.example, change your password now. #TallisBreach" — 212 reposts, 340 likes, 58 replies at 07:30.

actions.text: Volume alert: 'Tallis' mentions passed 200% of baseline.
Narrative cluster created: 'status page / site down' (@dealhunter_dayton and others).
Keyword alert: first match for 'Tallis hack'.
Capture: @DataLeakWatcher_x post with screenshot image; screenshot archived to listening record.
Volume alert: 'Tallis' mentions passed 400% of baseline.

planned: Keyword alerts on 'Tallis hack', 'Tallis breach' and 'tallishome.example' stay on real-time push.
Image match running on the forum screenshot to catch further reposts.
issues: One captured account exceeds 5,000 followers in the 'Tallis hack' / 'Tallis breach' keyword set (@DataLeakWatcher_x, 14,800).
#TallisRecall volume is outpacing the breach keywords and may bury them in the default dashboard view.
Screenshot text is an image; mentions of it without the words 'hack' or 'breach' may be missed by keyword matching.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject with one real signal in it. SOCIAL should log the recall rumor and the maintenance chatter as unrelated and leave them unanswered. They should flag the @DataLeakWatcher_x post to the cell because it passes the TMPCDI 5 threshold of more than 5,000 followers, record it word for word with the 07:24 time, and not reply. Watch whether anyone rushes out a recall denial or a breach reply before the fact sheet has anything on it.
